brief.headline: Push for a price cut of at least 2-3% — they keep 7.4% profit vs 5.0% for similar firms, so there's room in their price

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of 2-3% on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target price ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm caps (down from typical ₹0.85–0.95)
priceAsk.basis: Market asks show modest headroom at higher volume; they keep 7.4% profit vs 5.0% peer median, so margin exists to share

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (15 days vs current 30 days) in exchange for 3-4% off the price
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier costs us ₹1.64 L in cash, but they borrow at 7.02%, so early payment is worth about that rate to them — tie it to a matching or bigger price cut

brief.financialLeverage: They're healthy — CARE A+ rating, making ₹3373.51 Cr revenue and keeping 7.4% profit (better than the 5.0% peer median). Their cash is stuck for 78 days vs 71 for similar firms, so cash is a bit tight. But you're tiny to them — ₹39.99 L is 0.01% of their sales — so on your own you have little pull. Play the alternates hard: Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr, India's largest rigid converter) and Mold-Tek (₹1010.97 Cr, listed, health B 73/100) are both strong second sources for bottles and caps.

evidence.figure: ₹39.99 L spend = 0.01% of their ₹3373.51 Cr revenue

evidence.point: Their cash is stuck slightly longer than peers
Market asking price for 28 mm PP cap shows headroom
evidence.figure: ₹0.55–1.20/pc band; typical ₹0.85–0.95; verdict says modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume

evidence.point: Strong credit rating means low risk they'll stumble

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging firm (₹701.17 Cr revenue, health C 51/100) — broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: You're 0.01% of their sales — too small to matter on your own; bundle more volume or lock in a multi-year deal to get their attention
They show EPF payment delays and pending legal cases in their risk flags — watch for any service hiccups
Distress signal shows Altman Z-score 1.45 (grey zone) — not in trouble yet, but don't squeeze so hard you tip a fragile supplier; frame the ask around supply security and qualifying a second source
Paying 15 days early ties up ₹1.64 L of our cash — only do it if the price cut is at least 3-4% to cover our own cost of money
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work together on price — the market shows room at higher volume, and we're lining up Manjushree and Mold-Tek as second sources, so let's find a number that keeps you our first choice.
